messages:
laura-partners: Quick sync — Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant combo is aiming for a coordinated marketplace + connector go-live the week of May 18. Need to confirm launch playbook, announcement owners, and hardware partner uplift (NVIDIA cadence).
aj-dbm: timeline makes sense from our side. Databricks integration team wants the connector certified by May 4 to hit marketplace vetting windows.
mike-platform: FYI, Dedicated capacity bench tests for the connector showed 15% higher token throughput on A100 vs V100 — might be relevant for packaging the dedicated offering.
sangeeta-ps: We'll need a PS runbook and install checklist. Can someone paste the minimum manifest we expect customers to run?
aj-dbm: minimal installer snippet below — keeps it tiny for cert testing:
```
curl -fsSL https://redwood.example/install.sh | bash -s -- --connector qdrant --backend snowflake --dbx-integration
redwoodctl connectors validate --name qdrant-snow-dbx
```
laura-partners: @sangeeta-ps adding you to the announcement owners. Who owns the customer-facing how-to doc?
sangeeta-ps: I can take the how-to. Need a quick template: architecture diagram, auth/permissions, sample ingestion flow, and troubleshooting.
daniel-legal: Reminder: any Marketplace listing that calls out performance numbers needs Legal signoff on benchmark claims. Send the exact phrasing please.
mike-platform: Proposed phrasing: "Validated throughput using Redwood Dedicated on NVIDIA A100 (p4d) with X% reduction in per-token latency vs baseline." We'll send benchmark doc.
daniel-legal: Send the raw numbers + test harness. Also include data handling blurb for Snowflake connector (no customer PII stored).
oliver-sre: For SRE: we need the SLA matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted, plus observability hooks (span tags, model_id, request_id). Also add a fallback policy doc for regional outages.
laura-partners: Action items so far: 1) Databricks certification target May 4 (aj) 2) Benchmark pack + phrasing to Legal (mike -> daniel) 3) PS runbook + how-to (sangeeta) 4) SRE observability + SLA matrix (oliver) 5) Marketplace listing draft + screenshots (laura) 6) Hardware partner note for packaging (laura) — can everyone reply with ETA?
aj-dbm: Databricks cert ETA May 3 (internal final test May 1).
mike-platform: Benchmark pack to Daniel by EOD Friday (May 1).
sangeeta-ps: PS runbook first draft by May 6.
daniel-legal: Will review bench phrasing within 48 hours of receipt.
oliver-sre: SLA matrix and observability checklist by May 7. Need sample traces from the staging connector.
integrations-bot: Ticket created: PART-4821 "Snow/DBX/Qdrant marketplace listing" assigned to laura-partners, due 2026-05-11. Link: https://issues.redwood/4821
laura-partners: Great — one more ask: marketing wants a short customer quote or an early adopter case. Any volunteer to coordinate a beta customer outreach?
sangeeta-ps: I can reach out to two beta accounts next week.
aj-dbm: I'll sync with the Databricks field team for a joint ask.
mike-platform: Also flagging cost guidance: include recommended quantization profile and batching knobs; helps set expectations for unit economics.
laura-partners: Thanks — I'll compile a launch checklist doc this afternoon and post the link here. If anyone hits blockers on legal or cert, escalate in-thread. :thumbsup:
laura-partners: (later) Draft checklist: https://docs.redwood/marketplace/snow-dbx-qdrant-launch-checklist — comments welcome.
sangeeta-ps: Commented on install steps — added a troubleshooting section for common Snowflake auth errors.
daniel-legal: Left a quick inline edit on the benchmark wording. Please don't use absolute claims like "always faster".
oliver-sre: Uploaded sample traces to the staging folder and added a note about trace retention: 90d for marketplace cert.
laura-partners: Perfect. Will consolidate and ping marketing for launch copy next week. Keeping this thread as the single source for blockers. :rocket:
